art_direction: 浅藕粉底，粉天蓝侧带，左浅右阔，安稳正望。
composition_variation: Keep the left aperture particularly shallow and give the right eleven percent more height and breadth. Let both pupils face forward, slightly nearer the inner sides while maintaining parallel gaze. Round the broad upper brush swells and soften their tapered ends. Identical #97B9DA side bands remain clearly visible around the large flat black pupils; add one narrow elongated ivory glint each. Use a clearly visible but gentle dusty blush pink paper background, matching the exact palette below. Do not wash it out to white. Keep it flat and quiet with no gradients or decorative marks.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
style_inspiration: Three user-supplied chat images were inspected locally for asymmetric crescent eyes, pale half-lidded bowl eyes and diagonally arranged brush eyes. Prompt text alone was transmitted; no attachment was uploaded or used as binary input. The earlier eyes-only constraint is retained.
visual_review: passed: inspected compressed contact sheet; matching iris colors, the specified reference-family eye shape and subtle matte texture; exactly two eyes, no eyebrow/mouth/head, no square cuts, jelly rendering or watermark
